  AND (d:plm__PCA_100029511 OR d:plm__PCA_100029508 OR d:plm__PCA_100029510)

   OR toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029522, '')) CONTAINS 'liquid'
   OR toLower(coalesce(c.rdfs__label, '')) CONTAINS 'liquid'

final.answer: FV-2-2 can have equal-percentage, linear, or quick-opening flow characteristics.

final.answer: The maximum casing pressure for P-1-1 is 266 psi (1834 kPa).

cypher:
MATCH (p:PlantItem {tag: 'P-1-1'})-[:DESCRIBED_BY]->(dev)
CALL {
  WITH dev, p
  MATCH (d)
  WHERE d.document_id = dev.document_id
    AND (d:plm__PCA_100029511 OR d:plm__PCA_100029508 OR d:plm__PCA_100029510)
    AND (
      toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'pressure'
      OR toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'casing'
      OR toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029522, '')) CONTAINS 'pressure'
      OR toLower(coalesce(d.plm__PCA_100029522, '')) CONTAINS 'casing'
      OR EXISTS {
        MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029520]->(c:plm__PCA_100029524)
        WHERE toLower(coalesce(c.rdfs__label, '')) CONTAINS 'pressure'
           OR toLower(coalesce(c.rdfs__label, '')) CONTAINS 'casing'
      }
    )
  OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029520]->(caseNode:plm__PCA_100029524)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029514]->(footnote)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029525]->(src:plm__PCA_100029513)
  RETURN p.tag AS tag,
         d.plm__PCA_100029521 AS label,
         d.plm__PCA_100029522 AS printed_value,
         caseNode.rdfs__label AS case_label,
         footnote.plm__PCA_100029522 AS footnote_text,
         src.plm__PCA_100029521 AS source_title,
         src.dct__type AS source_type,
         src.dct__description AS source_description,
         src.schema__pageStart AS page
  UNION
  WITH dev, p
  MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029525]->(src:plm__PCA_100029513)
  WHERE d.document_id = dev.document_id
    AND (d:plm__PCA_100029511 OR d:plm__PCA_100029508 OR d:plm__PCA_100029510)
    AND (
      toLower(coalesce(src.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'pressure'
      OR toLower(coalesce(src.plm__PCA_100029521, '')) CONTAINS 'casing'
      OR toLower(coalesce(src.dct__description, '')) CONTAINS 'pressure'
      OR toLower(coalesce(src.dct__description, '')) CONTAINS 'casing'
    )
  OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029520]->(caseNode:plm__PCA_100029524)
  OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:plm__PCA_100029514]->(footnote)
  RETURN p.tag AS tag,
         d.plm__PCA_100029521 AS label,
         d.plm__PCA_100029522 AS printed_value,
         caseNode.rdfs__label AS case_label,
         footnote.plm__PCA_100029522 AS footnote_text,
